purpose: Freeze source-reported validation summary values for benchmark design. This file is not the authors' raw telemetry, the authors' simulation, or an independent replication.

references.title: A Validated Physics-Based Powertrain Model for an Electric Motorcycle in Sub-Saharan Africa
methods: motor and inverter efficiency maps from dynamometer measurements
limitations_reported: grade estimation from GPS/elevation introduces bias
energy result is not a full wall-plug-to-wheel model
battery thermal/electrochemical model remains future work

references.title: A Validated Full-Powertrain Digital Twin of an Electric Motorcycle Developed for Sub-Saharan African Conditions
methods: pack-level Hybrid Pulse Power Characterisation tests
limitations_reported: mechanical braking not included in validation dataset/model
battery temperature and ageing effects omitted
wind speed estimated rather than directly measured
short downhill/high throttle-transient trip produced higher percentage error
transfer to other powertrain configurations not yet validated
references.data_note: This summary is transcribed from the published article. It does not contain raw timestamped telemetry, component maps, calibration files, or model source required to independently reproduce the digital twin.

benchmark_design_implications: Treat source-reported summary metrics as reference metadata, not benchmark input traces.
Do not claim replication until raw data and component parameters are available with appropriate reuse rights.
Retain the short downhill/high-transient outlier; pair relative percentage error with absolute Wh and Wh/km error.
Expand held-out coverage across payload, road grade, surface, posture, wind, battery state-of-charge, temperature, and mechanical braking.
Use an independent implementation only as a cross-check, not as replacement for the published model or physical validation.
